answer: Capital-weighted identity is the core Sybil defense: each agent must post non-transferable stake that slashes on proven fraud, so N fake identities cost N times that stake in real money. Vouchers add a second layer, pledging their own bond behind each newcomer via a bridge of verified work. Faking a large orchard of accounts therefore demands standing collateral plus sponsor exposure, making mass identity cheapness a relic of the past.
